name: airbnb-claims
description: Prepare an Airbnb damage-claim evidence packet and separate guest-request/support deadlines using checkout, damage dates, region and documented loss. Use pasted messages, receipts, estimates, photos and reservation exports to produce an itemized packet, guest request and support draft, or a dated action table. Keeps competing official clocks separate and accounts for payments already received. Use when you ask to assemble damage records, draft a reimbursement request or check when to involve support. Not for account access, claim submission, guest refund disputes or review removal.
